name: ente-auth
description: Get TOTP codes from Ente Auth. Port of the Raycast Ente Auth extension.
author: rulasfia

commands.name: get-totp
commands.title: Get TOTP
commands.description: Search an Ente Auth account and copy or paste its TOTP code

commands.name: import-secrets
commands.title: Import Secrets
commands.description: Export from the Ente CLI and store secrets encrypted, keyed by the system keychain

commands.name: export-secrets
commands.title: Export Secrets
commands.description: Run the Ente CLI export and list the exported accounts. Leaves a plaintext file.

commands.name: delete-export
commands.title: Delete Export
commands.description: Delete the plaintext ente_auth.txt export and the CLI's backup copies

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Ente CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the ente binary, or a bare name resolved from PATH.

preferences.name: exportPath
preferences.title: Ente CLI Export Location
preferences.description: Leave empty to use the Ente CLI's configured export dir. If set, the CLI's auth account is pointed here.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: What Enter does on a code.

preferences.name: deleteExport
preferences.title: Privacy
preferences.label: Delete export file after import
preferences.description: The export contains every secret in plaintext.

preferences.name: fetchIcons
preferences.title: Service Icons
preferences.label: Download service icons
preferences.description: Looks up service names on GitHub (Ente icon registry) and the Simple Icons CDN.

title: Ente Auth
